variables.name: pr_title
variables.sample: Capture payment after the order is confirmed

variables.name: pr_author
variables.description: The pull request's author; empty when GitHub did not say.

variables.name: model
variables.description: The model that reviewed it, provider/id.

variables.name: summary_line
variables.description: One sentence: how many new issues, none, or that the run did not complete.

variables.name: findings_list
variables.description: One line per new finding: severity, title and file:line; empty when there are none.
variables.sample:
- High: Payment captured before the order is confirmed (`src/checkout/capture.ts:42`)
- Medium (unconfirmed): Retry loop has no upper bound (`src/checkout/retry.ts:17`)

variables.name: findings_count
variables.description: How many new findings this review lists.

variables.name: unconfirmed_count
variables.description: New findings the reviewer suspects but could not show from the code.

variables.name: carried
variables.description: Findings from earlier commits, under a heading per state; empty when there are none.
variables.sample:
Still present from an earlier commit:

- Low: Log line prints the card's last four digits (`src/checkout/log.ts:9`, first reported on `b131fd0`)

variables.name: limitations
variables.description: One “Scope limited: …” line per limit on what was reviewed; empty when none.
